module: Capture submodule of the screenshotCreator tool: takes an off-screen capture of a vehicle from a given camera, via a dedicated render view (render_renderViews, "thumbnailScreenshot" view). The UI and markers are not displayed; the render view takes the main view's exposure and waits 1 s by default for post-processing effects to converge. The capture is rendered at resolution × supersampling then downscaled.
notes: captureFramedThumbnail must be called from a coroutine: it waits with coroutine.yield until the capture is finished or the maximum delay is reached.
Default resolution 500x281, default supersampling 4, default field of view 20 degrees, default near plane 0.1.
The existing file is deleted before the capture. The "Saved screenshot" message is logged before the capture is finished.
The render view mask (bit 63) is that of the reflection map.

captureFramedThumbnail.desc: Captures an off-screen thumbnail and waits for it to finish (coroutine). Uses the main view's far plane distance so that depth-based effects (depth blur) stay consistent.

options.desc: resolution {width, height}, supersampling, fov, nearPlane, captureTimeout (seconds, default 5, minimum 0.1)

returns.desc: true if the capture succeeded and the file exists with a non-zero size

takeThumbnailScreenshot.desc: Starts the capture via render_renderViews.takeScreenshot without waiting (asynchronous). Warns and calls the callback with no argument if filepath or camera (pos and rot) are invalid.

callback.desc: Called at the end with the capture result
